_about: Patrol boat (Track WS, 2026-10-10: water). ALEX'S (decisions water-layer and boat-looks): one armed patrol boat, the P1 Cutter (27 m); 'part of the environment with real patrols but no specific part in the mission'; its guns fire ('Let it fire if it wants'). EVERYTHING ELSE HERE IS PROPOSED by Track WS. The planes' movement system with a boat's numbers: the same envelope (data/units/_schema.json), on the surface band, a slow turn that needs way on, a speed of 10 m/s (about 19 knots) against a fighter's 100: a boat covers 25 m in a 2.5 s step and 50 m in a turn, so a coastal loop of two kilometres is forty turns round. It can reverse once stopped (reverse_from_stop). The WATER RULE (World.set_water, data/sim/sea.json): its steps stay on water at least draught_m deep, at its centre and at both ends of its hull; a step that would leave it is slowed, and held if even the slowest leaves it. Its guns are MACHINE GUNS, weapon deck_mg (ALEX, decision weapon-kinds, 2026-10-11: 'Machine guns would be bullets which don't [explode]. But Flak is pointed up and machine guns are around and less up.'; on the mapping 'the mobile AA's quad mount and the cutter's guns are machine guns, the cruiser's AA is flak': '5 good'). They were the id aa_guns, the battery's light flak's cone shared with the mobile AA and the cruiser. Now: two mounts, fore and aft as the P1 is drawn (data/world/boats.json), all around and LESS UP (from the horizon to 50 degrees, PROPOSED), so they do not reach a plane straight over the boat, short (320 m effective, so they reach the low band round the boat and never the medium band), the same volume of fire as before (two mounts at half the battery's light flak's roll rate). They draw tracers (data/fx/fx.json tracers.weapons). It carries no bombs. At 0 health it is DESTROYED (fate 'destroyed': it stays where it was, down; the drawing may sink it). Numbers are plausible for a 1940s harbour-defence launch / motor gunboat, scaled to the 5 km map.
name: Patrol boat

size_m._reason: the P1 Cutter's length (data/world/boats.json patrol.size_m, three light fighters long): a WWII motor gunboat or harbour launch is 20 to 35 m

draught_m._reason: a 27 m gunboat draws 1.5 to 2 m; it keeps to water at least this deep, which in the generator's sea (data/world/water.json: 6 m of depth about 115 m out from a coast) is a few tens of metres off the shore, so the loop's own margin (data/world/water.json sites.patrol.margin_m) is what keeps it clear, not the draught

actions_per_turn._reason: a slow unit plans two points a turn (2.5 s steps, data/sim/turn.json): a step is 25 m at cruise, short enough that the water rule (data/sim/sea.json) samples it every few metres and the arc is the boat's own turn, and few enough that a boat is not tedious to plan

health._reason: a small steel launch: as hard to sink as a heavy fighter (5), two direct bomb hits (3 each) or eight or so rounds of a fighter's guns; the bombs (data/sim/bombs.json) take 3 for a hit within 12 m, 2 within 25 m, 1 within 45 m, so a stick near it sinks it

sight_range_m._reason: lookouts on a low deck: a little under the radio tower's 500 m. The enemy AI counts what its units see (scripts/sim/ai_sense.gd), so a boat that sees a plane tells the patrol; the boats have no part in the mission, so this is kept short

enabled._reason: a boat smokes when hit; a SUNK boat draws no damage (decision ship-sinks), this is a damaged hull still afloat

source_m._reason: the engine room and exhaust of a 27 m launch, not its length

source_back_m._reason: the engine room is aft of the middle: 6 m behind the centre of a 27 m hull

rise_mps._reason: the smoulder's rate: a damaged ground or sea unit smokes like a ruin or a wreck (data/fx/fx.json ruin R1 and crash A smolder rise_mps 4.0), so its puffs climb into the faster air above and the plume leans downwind (decisions smoke-consistency, wind-with-height). PROPOSED

shape._about: One box (the P1 cutter). Every number PROPOSED.

stamp._reason: a target, not scenery: other lines are not blocked by it

length_m._reason: PROPOSED by builder LOF1 (2026-10-11, decision line-of-fire): 27 m, the unit's size_m

width_m._reason: PROPOSED by builder LOF1 (2026-10-11, decision line-of-fire): 6 m, a motor gunboat's beam

bottom_m._reason: PROPOSED by builder LOF1 (2026-10-11, decision line-of-fire): from the water's surface

top_m._reason: PROPOSED by builder LOF1 (2026-10-11, decision line-of-fire): 4 m, a bridge house over the deck (the machine guns are at 2.5 m)

speed_min_mps._reason: slow astern: a boat can reverse once stopped (design doc, Motion and inertia: ships can reverse once stopped), which is also how it backs off a shore the water rule has held it at

speed_cruise_mps._reason: about 19 knots: a coastal patrol's steady speed, a tenth of a light fighter's

speed_max_mps._reason: about 29 knots: a motor gunboat's top speed

dive_speed_max_mps._reason: a boat cannot dive: equal to speed_max_mps

accel_mps2._reason: from a stop to cruise in about eight seconds (three steps): a light hull with a lot of power

decel_mps2._reason: water drag and the engines astern: a boat stops in about five seconds from cruise, faster than it gets going

reverse_from_stop._reason: design doc, Motion and inertia: ships can reverse once stopped; speed cannot cross zero within a step

turn_rate_curve_dps._reason: a rudder needs flow (data/units/_schema.json): no turn with no way on, rising to 10 deg/s at cruise, a little less flat out. At cruise that is a turn radius of 57 m (two hull lengths) and a full circle in 36 s, seven turns: a slow turn beside a fighter's 18 s at ten times the speed

turn_bleed_mps2._reason: a boat loses a little way in a hard turn (the rudder and the slip): at the full rate 0.6 m/s per second, 1.5 m/s over a step

turn_bleed_exponent._reason: as the planes' (induced drag): gentle turns are nearly free

altitude_bands._reason: it rides the sea: the surface band (data/sim/altitude.json). The bombs reach it (they hurt a unit at the surface)

hardpoints._reason: the two gun mounts of the P1 Cutter as it is drawn (data/world/boats.json patrol.looks.p1: fore at 0.16 to 0.18 and aft at 0.82 to 0.84 of the length, twin mounts under shields): 0.33 of 27 m, 8.9 m, forward and aft of the middle, 2.5 m above the water. Each mount rolls on its own

mount_deg._reason: the cone is all around (half_across_deg 180), so the mount does not matter; 0 is the bow

half_across_deg._reason: all around (Alex, weapon-kinds: machine guns are 'around'): the guns fire at anything in their height band whichever way the boat points (a boat turns slowly, its mounts train)

elevation_deg._reason: PROPOSED (decision weapon-kinds; Alex: machine guns are 'around and less up'): the middle of a band from the horizon (0 degrees) to 50 degrees up. Was 46, the flak's cone. The lower edge is the HORIZON, not a little below it (the lead's example was -5): the muzzles are 2.5 m up and every surface unit is at 0 m, so a cone that starts below the horizon would let the boat shoot other boats and tanks from 30 m out, a ground-fire rule nobody has decided (strafing and ground fire are deferred, decision strafe-later)

half_height_deg._reason: PROPOSED (decision weapon-kinds): from the horizon to 50 degrees up (centre 25, half 25). Was 44 (2 degrees to straight up). A low plane (117 m above the muzzles) is above 50 degrees from any point inside 98 m of a mount on the water: a blind disc under the plane that flak, which points up, does not have. A medium plane is 519 m away at 50 degrees, over the guns' reach (384 m), so the boat never touches the medium band, as before

effective_range_m._reason: the battery's LIGHT flak (data/units/anti_aircraft_battery.json): short, so it covers the low band (120 m) round the boat and not the medium band (400 m; its reach of 384 m is under the 397 m of a plane right over it). A plane at medium is never touched by a boat

base_hit_chance._reason: the battery's light flak's own per-roll chance, unchanged by decision weapon-kinds (only the cone changed). MEASURED 2026-10-11 (builder AA, tmp/aa/aa_probe.gd): expected pips per pass of a bomber at cruise in the low band, straight over the boat / 300 m aside, 1.96 / 0.85 as flak, 1.49 / 0.85 as machine guns (a light fighter 1.61 / 0.71 -> 1.23 / 0.71); the medium band 0 both ways

rim_odds_factor._reason: flat, as every flexible gun: a gun crew aims within the arc

falloff_exponent._reason: no effect while the factor is flat (rim_odds_factor 1)

tracking_dps._reason: the battery's light flak: fast tracking, a light gun

damage_pips._reason: one pip a hit like every other gun

rolls_per_second._reason: half the battery's light flak (4 a second) on each of TWO mounts, so the boat puts out the battery's light flak's volume (0.28 hits a second on a plane in range before the other factors): the boat is a light flak battery that moves, not a stronger one
